messages:
olivia-partners: Quick check-in 024-09 vendor demo choreography. Need to confirm multi-region fallback, SI dry-run slots, and press embargo windows. Thinking: two vendor days (H100/H200/MI300/Gaudi) + one cloud marketplace day. Thoughts?

raj-hw: Heads up 024-09 MI300 will be on a staggered driver roll; latest recommended image is `mi300-img:20240910`. Gaudi needs kernel 6.2+ like we discussed. H200 boards arriving late could force B200 fallback for some demos.

toni-ops: Lab inventory:
```
us-west-1: H100 x6 (bench-w1), B200 x4 (bench-w2)
eu-central-1: MI300 x4 (bench-e1), Gaudi x8 (bench-e2)
```
We can do concurrent region demos but network replay/latency checks must be run. Also our on-call for that weekend is thin 10/12-13.

eli-devex: I'll own SI dry-run templates and the speaker checklist. Propose SI dry-run on 2024-09-22 09:00 PT (US west) and a separate EU slot 2024-09-23 09:00 CEST. Will add checklist items: kernel image, firmware tag, sample prompts, perf baselines.

sam-sales: Marketing asks for a crisp fallback matrix for press FAQ: e.g., if H100 unavailable -> hosted H100 instance; if MI300 regression -> fall back to MI300-quant or GAUDI for cost demo. Also need clear numbers: p99 latency, throughput, and estimated cost delta.

olivia-partners: Good. Let's keep hero demos to 3: low-latency convo (H100), large-batch embeddings (MI300), and cost-per-token comparison (Gaudi vs B200). If H200 arrives, we can add a rack-level throughput demo.

raj-hw: Note: firmware freeze for MI300 starts 2024-09-24 00:00 UTC. No driver/firmware toggles after that without signoff. Also pushing `lab-img:gaudi-6.2-20240914` to staging tomorrow.

toni-ops: Reservation plan (provisional):
```
reserve --bench bench-w1 --sku H100 --start 2024-09-22T09:00Z --end 2024-09-22T12:00Z --owner olivia
reserve --bench bench-e1 --sku MI300 --start 2024-09-22T13:00Z --end 2024-09-22T17:00Z --owner olivia
reserve --bench bench-e2 --sku Gaudi --start 2024-09-23T09:00Z --end 2024-09-23T12:00Z --owner olivia
```
I'll convert to confirmed once we have explicit 705 from engineering and comms.

sam-sales: Proposed public announce: 2024-09-27 17:00 UTC (10:00 PT). Embargo lifts at that time. Need comms copy + one-line about fallback routing (hosted vs dedicated) for engineers FAQ.

eli-devex: I'll draft the runbook and include a short rollback playbook (how to revert to known-good image and how to switch to hosted fallback). Can someone provide the hosted H100 endpoint and B200 endpoint URIs?

raj-hw: Hosted endpoints: `https://hosted.redwood.ai/v1/h100` and `https://hosted.redwood.ai/v1/b200`. Note network egress could add ~10-30ms p50. Mention in comms.

ci-bot: CI note: please ensure demo branches are using pinned model versions. Detected a failing perf test on `demo/h100-lowlat`.

olivia-partners: Action items: olivia add hero demo bullets for marketing; raj freeze firmware after 9/24 unless emergency; eli finish runbook + SI invites; toni reserve labs after 705s from owners. Reply with :white_check_mark: if you can commit to the dates.

sam-sales: I'll coord comms + press list. will add latency vs cost bullets.

raj-hw: :white_check_mark: for firmware and images.

toni-ops: :white_check_mark: will tentatively reserve then confirm.

toni-ops: :white_check_mark: will tentatively reserve then confirm.

eli-devex: :white_check_mark: SI dry-run invites sent to partners.

olivia-partners: :white_check_mark: will send hero list by EOD today.
